session.zh: 跨市场收盘 · 美国 9 月 4 日 / 香港 9 月 7 日
session.en: Cross-market close · US Sep 4 / Hong Kong Sep 7

headline.zh: 强就业压低美股，存储景气仍强但周期风险上升。
headline.en: Strong jobs weigh on US stocks; memory stays firm as cycle risk rises.

summary.zh: 截至上海时间 9 月 8 日早晨，美国最近一个完整交易日为 9 月 4 日，标普 500 与纳指分别下跌 0.4% 和 0.3%；9 月 7 日美国劳动节休市。香港恒指 9 月 7 日下跌 0.93%。宏观层面，8 月非农增加 16.2 万、失业率维持 4.1%，令利率路径重新成为高估值科技股的主要折现变量。行业层面，TrendForce 估算 2Q26 DRAM 收入环比增长 59.5%，但这是景气证据，不是周期永久消失的证据。
summary.en: As of the morning of September 8 in Shanghai, the latest completed US session was September 4: the S&P 500 fell 0.4% and the Nasdaq 0.3%; US markets were closed for Labor Day on September 7. Hong Kong's Hang Seng fell 0.93% on September 7. August payrolls rose 162,000 while unemployment held at 4.1%, putting the rate path back at the center of long-duration tech valuations. TrendForce estimates 2Q26 DRAM revenue rose 59.5% QoQ—evidence of a strong cycle, not proof that cyclicality has disappeared.

title.zh: 需求证据仍在，折现率与供给反应开始更重要。
title.en: Demand evidence holds; discount rates and supply response matter more.

detail.zh: 云与 AI 的基本面证据没有被一个交易日推翻，但强就业、较高利率预期和高估值共同放大回撤风险。内存行业的收入跃升支持 AI 基础设施需求，同时也提高未来扩产、库存和价格基数的验证门槛。
detail.en: One trading day does not overturn the cloud and AI fundamentals, but strong employment, higher rate expectations and rich valuations amplify drawdown risk. The memory revenue surge supports AI-infrastructure demand while raising the bar for future capacity, inventory and pricing checks.

title.zh: 美国就业重新抬高利率敏感度

detail.zh: 美国劳工统计局确认 8 月非农就业增加 16.2 万，失业率为 4.1%；美股 9 月 4 日收低。前者是已确认事实，市场对政策路径的解读属于分析判断。
detail.en: The BLS confirmed August payrolls rose 162,000 and unemployment held at 4.1%; US stocks closed lower on September 4. The data are confirmed facts; the market-policy interpretation is analysis.

title.zh: 香港大盘走弱，观察名单内部有分化
title.en: Hong Kong weakens with watchlist dispersion

detail.zh: 9 月 7 日恒指跌 0.93%；腾讯收报 HK$438.40、跌约 1%，泡泡玛特收报 HK$156.20、涨约 1.4%。单日分化不构成 thesis 变化。
detail.en: On September 7 the Hang Seng fell 0.93%; Tencent closed at HK$438.40, down about 1%, while Pop Mart closed at HK$156.20, up about 1.4%. One-day dispersion does not change a thesis.

title.zh: DRAM 景气兑现，但不要外推为永久短缺
title.en: DRAM strength is real, not permanent

detail.zh: TrendForce 估算 2Q26 DRAM 行业收入环比增长 59.5%，并预计 3Q26 传统 DRAM 合约价环比涨幅放缓至 13%–18%。这支持当前景气判断，也提醒投资者跟踪供给迁移与价格增速。
detail.en: TrendForce estimates 2Q26 DRAM industry revenue rose 59.5% QoQ and expects conventional DRAM contract-price growth to moderate to 13%–18% QoQ in 3Q26. This supports the current upcycle while keeping supply migration and pricing momentum on watch.
